body:
## What's Changed
* Add support for Cython >=3 and keep support for Cython < 3 by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/99
* Now Github Actions provides python3 via setup-python also for Apple Silicon Macs by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/98
* Add support for Python 3.12 (tests, wheel, docs) by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/100
* Fixes the build on `kivy-ios`, as we do not have access to `Cython` by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/101
* Bump version to `1.2.3` by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/102
* Add (now mandatory) `.readthedocs.yaml` file, add docs extras and update sphinx conf by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/103


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/compare/v1.2.2...v1.2.3
name: Release v1.2.3

body:
## What's Changed
* Fix github release token by @matham in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/86
* Our self-hosted Apple Silicon runner now has been migrated to actions/runner v2.292.0 which now supports arm64 natively by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/87
* Universal2 builds by default for python3.8 upwards on macOS. by @akshayaurora in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/92
* Add Discord and remove IRC from support channels by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/94
* Add Python 3.11 to test matrix and update supported python versions list by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/93
* Bump version to `1.2.2` by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/95

## New Contributors
* @akshayaurora made their first contribution in https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/pull/92

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kivy/pyobjus/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2
